baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active feminine plural عاصفات plus the cognate accusative عصفا intensifies root ع ص ف as an enacted operation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Multiple force-bearers storm with enough violence to lift, carry, and break encountered matter into debris.

activation_trace.role: A violent wind that sweeps things away supplies both the literal motion and the force that breaks what it carries.

changed_reading.after: Those that execute a maximally forceful sweep, lifting, scattering, and breaking what lies in their path.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root occurs in both عاصفات and عصفا, while its inventory joins the storming action to its chaff-like product.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root can foreground a material conversion: a coherent body is reduced to light, dry, mobile residue.

activation_trace.role: Dry crop chaff and broken straw supply the resulting material state of fragmentation.
The violent wind supplies the operation that can turn material into chaff-like debris.

changed_reading.after: A chaff-making sweep that changes stable material into friable, dispersible remnants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active plural construction and emphatic root repetition can select the root's light, swift-motion branch without fixing an agent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase presents a synchronized surge whose defining property is rapid, lightly unimpeded forward motion.

activation_trace.role: Light, swift propulsion supplies a speed-centered reading broader than meteorological wind.

changed_reading.before: Storm winds as a named object.
changed_reading.after: Unidentified plural agents defined functionally by an emphatic, rapid rush.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Root ع ص ف has a branch in which wind or war sweeps a people away, and عصفا intensifies that terminal force.
baseline_models.mechanism: The motion is measured by its endpoint: resistance and collective integrity are removed, not merely disturbed.

activation_trace.role: A force that sweeps a people into destruction supplies the terminal, group-removing effect.

changed_reading.after: A sweeping destructive operation whose completion is the removal of what resisted it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's B005 branch links عصف to earning, labor, and resourceful acquisition; the cognate accusative can intensify that exertion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Motion and tactical effort are directed toward acquiring sustenance rather than toward scattering an external object.

activation_trace.role: Resourceful striving for livelihood supplies a form-distant but packet-attested purposive motion.

changed_reading.after: Those that exert themselves resourcefully and intensely in pursuit of provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: A connected dispatch enters a violent transport-and-clearance phase; what follows can then be opened out, differentiated, and cast as a reminder.

activation_trace.role: The violent sweep supplies the central transport and clearance operation.
Swift light motion supplies acceleration between the surrounding stages.
Sending and dispatch supply the launch condition for the process.
A connected succession like mane-hairs supplies ordered continuity rather than random gusting.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the first downstream transformation.
Distinguishing two things supplies a discriminating stage after spreading.
Casting something outward supplies the delivery operation at the end of the chain.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the delivered content.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 forms an opening chain of feminine active plurals, with fa-connectors placing 77:2 and 77:4-5 as linked phases.
The focus's cognate accusative matches the emphatic action-noun pattern repeated in 77:3-4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, succession, storming, spreading, separation, and casting reminder; I supply the directional pipeline in which the sweep accelerates and clears for later stages. A live alternative is a set of coordinate oath images with no causal handoff.

changed_reading.before: An isolated image of violent storming.
changed_reading.after: The high-energy transit and clearance phase inside an ordered transmission-and-discrimination sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sweep turns coherent matter into mobile chaff-like fractions; spreading and sifting expose those fractions, while containment and gathering show that the result can be sorted rather than simply erased.

activation_trace.role: Chaff and broken straw supply the granular product of the focus operation.
The storm supplies the breakage and mobilization that produce the fractions.
Opening and spreading supply spatial exposure of the newly mobile material.
Scattering into parts supplies explicit fractionation after the sweep.
Shaking and sifting with a sieve supplies a material sorting analogue.
Gathering and gripping in a vessel supply containment of what was dispersed.
Joining the dispersed into a collected whole supplies the terminal counter-operation.

structural_cues: The opening نشر-to-فرق sequence is echoed materially by mountain نسف.
Earth as كفات and the later جمع oppose dispersion with containment and collection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chaff, breakage, spreading, parting, sifting, containment, and gathering; I infer that fragmentation makes constituents sortable. The live alternative is terminal pulverization with no preserved or selected fractions.

changed_reading.after: The sweep is a granularizing threshold that makes a previously coherent whole available for separation, containment, and sorting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The destructive sweep becomes a systematic unmaking of visible order: marks disappear, enclosure opens, and elevated solid anchors are removed into flying residue.

activation_trace.role: Sweeping destructive force supplies the focus's capacity to remove an established order.
Erasing and wiping away traces supply loss of visible marks.
An opened breach between two sides supplies rupture of enclosure.
A high, hard mass supplies the strongest image of stable material structure.
Uprooting and removal from place supply the loss of structural anchorage.
Flying sifted matter supplies the debris state produced by unmaking.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 presents a compact progression from erased lights to opened sky to removed mountains.
The focus precedes that progression within the same whole-surah oath and fulfillment structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sweeping destruction and the ordered loss of marks, enclosure, and anchors; I infer a single deconfiguration mechanism and treat the focus as its operative signature. The alternatives are analogy rather than causation, or independent scenes joined only by the surah's sequence.

changed_reading.after: An operation that deconfigures an entire stable order by stripping its signs, boundaries, and anchors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's swift rush is constrained by a promised, fixed, measured endpoint, turning speed into temporal compression toward an event that will settle into actuality.

activation_trace.role: Light, rapid propulsion supplies the trajectory's speed.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies a destination for the rush.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies arrival as realized actuality.
Assigning a time or limit supplies explicit temporal constraint.
A prescribed terminal time supplies the bounded endpoint.
Ordering an affair by measure and deliberation supplies directed rather than random motion.

structural_cues: 77:7 converts the oath sequence into a claim of certain occurrence.
77:11-13 repeats appointment, delay, and the day of separation before 77:22-23 repeats measure and measuring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speed, appointment, occurrence, fixed time, term, and measure; I supply the arrow that makes the swift sweep an approach toward that endpoint. A live alternative is qualitative violence with no temporal meaning.

changed_reading.before: Fast movement without a specified direction.
changed_reading.after: An accelerated, measured approach that compresses the interval before a fixed event becomes actual.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's chaff and livelihood branches meet a growth-to-yield sequence, work and wages, and a split context root whose inventories hold both recompense and cutting at harvest; the sweep becomes a threshing operation that renders labor into separated yield and return.

activation_trace.role: Crop chaff and broken straw supply the residue and threshing domain.
Resourceful earning supplies the purposive livelihood side of the operation.
Earth revived by rain and vegetation supplies the growth phase before harvest.
The yield of trees and crops supplies the edible product.
Wages and the worker's provision supply the conversion of labor into return.
Recompensing an act supplies the accounting side of the result.
The non-dominant mapped inventory's harvest-time cutting supplies the material harvest side.

structural_cues: The whole-surah package places creation, water, earth, life, food, work, and recompense around the focus's crop-residue branch.
The packet preserves both mapped targets for ج ز ي rather than collapsing recompense into the dominant target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crop residue, livelihood striving, vegetative life, edible yield, wages, recompense, and a non-dominant harvest branch; I overlay these as one harvest-accounting mechanism. The materially live alternative is that the split mapped branches are unrelated lexical possibilities and only recompense is active at 77:44.

changed_reading.before: Either destructive storming or, distantly, vigorous earning.
changed_reading.after: A threshing-and-harvest operation that separates yield from residue and figures work as something brought to return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The physical sweep transfers to forensic exposure: coverings and defensive residue are stripped away, an opening reveals what was concealed, and later speech, permission, and apology can no longer rebuild a defense.

activation_trace.role: The object-sweeping wind supplies removal of obstructing or concealing material.
The branch image of excuses as curtains supplies a packet-grounded bridge from physical cover to defense.
Uncovering what ought to be veiled supplies exposure after the covering is removed.
Speech supplies the defensive capacity that is explicitly absent later.
Permission supplies the procedural gate that is closed to further defense.
Apology supplies the attempted defense that the later scene does not permit.

structural_cues: The opening sequence places excuse or warning immediately after the forceful stages.
77:35-36 later joins inability to speak, lack of permission, and inability to apologize.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical sweeping, a branch that images excuses as curtains, exposure, and the later closure of speech and apology; I supply the cross-domain arrow from sweeping matter to stripping defenses. The live alternative is a wholly physical sweep followed by an independent forensic scene.

changed_reading.before: A force that clears physical objects.
changed_reading.after: An exposing force that strips away the coverings under which an excuse or verbal defense could shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers storm pressure into posture and pride. It remains anchored in the focus branch that sweeps resistant groups away, while high hard mass, raised-nose pride, and bending supply the contrast; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain activation, not as an identification of the عاصفات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عاصفات عصفا, through B004's emphatic sweeping destruction of resistance.

activation_trace.role: Sweeping destructive force supplies the pressure that removes what remains rigid.
A high hard mass supplies the physical extreme of rigidity under pressure.
Raising the nose in pride supplies a social posture of resistant elevation.
Bending and lowering the head supply the voluntary posture opposed to rigid elevation.
Humility supplies the affective counterpart to physical bending.

changed_reading.before: A force that destroys whatever is present.
changed_reading.after: A pressure that exposes the difference between voluntary yielding and rigidity that must be broken and scattered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps crop fragmentation onto collective identity. It remains anchored in the focus's chaff and people-sweeping branches and is activated by separating groups, tribal aggregation, and gathering the dispersed; downstream prose should qualify it as a social-mechanical analogy, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ع ص ف construction, through B001 chaff-production and B004 group-sweeping destruction.

activation_trace.role: Chaff-like fragmentation supplies the image of a whole reduced to separate light units.
Sweeping a people away licenses a social rather than merely material target domain.
A separated faction, team, or flock supplies group identity under division.
A people that gathers tribes supplies the collective whole that can lose cohesion.
Gathering the dispersed supplies the inverse operation and confirms that dispersed units remain addressable.

changed_reading.before: Material is broken and blown apart.
changed_reading.after: Collective protections and affiliations are deaggregated into separately gatherable and distinguishable persons.

strongest_changes: The opening context revises an isolated storm into the high-energy middle phase of an ordered dispatch, spreading, separation, and delivery process.
The focus's crop-residue branch becomes a granular sorting mechanism when read with spreading, separation, sifting, containment, and gathering.
The later erasure, opening, and removal of mountains scales the sweep into systematic deconfiguration of a stable order.
Appointment, occurrence, timing, term, and measure redirect the swift-motion branch toward a fixed endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package kept the compact focus attached to several distant mechanisms without forcing one referent. Most distinctive was the split ج ز ي inventory: recompense and non-dominant harvest-cutting activated the focus's otherwise remote chaff and livelihood branches as one explicitly exploratory harvest-accounting reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus and context do not by themselves settle the identity of the feminine plural agents.
The opening forms may be one causal pipeline, coordinated oath images, or a mixture of both.
The cosmic sequence may be caused by the focus operation or may only instantiate an analogous pattern of unmaking.
The harvest-accounting model depends on carrying two mapped possibilities for ج ز ي together; they may instead remain unrelated alternatives.
